quotes.text: The former one-time mail.startup.enabledMailCheckOnce migration forced defaultServer.loginAtStartUp to true when the main window loaded, including for profiles that deliberately disabled it. The accepted fix removed that override and removed a legacy wizard helper that also enabled loginAtStartUp and downloadOnBiff. The wizard still selects a default account if needed. New account configuration has its own loginAtStartup: true default. When changing startup behavior, keep account selection separate from changing a stored server preference.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
